summary: Examples of raw: bootstrapping Python with dnf, using bash for shell features, quoting templated variables to avoid injection, and running PowerShell on Windows.
questions: How do I bootstrap python3 with raw?
How do I safely use variables in a raw command?
How do I run PowerShell with raw on Windows?

answer_card.title: raw examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.raw: dnf install -y python3 python3-libdnf
- ansible.builtin.raw: cat < /tmp/*txt
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
- ansible.builtin.raw: "{{ package_mgr|quote }} {{ pkg_flags|quote }} install {{ python|quote }}"
- ansible.builtin.raw: Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_UserAccount
```
Always use `| quote` on templated values.
